description: November 7 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 2, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 7 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the second decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: November 7 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Mystery is almost a default setting for November 7. The Sun at fourteen degrees of Scorpio is in the Neptune decan, linked with intuition and the unseen, and the birthday number 7 is numerology's contemplative seeker. Few dates lean so far inward. The interpretive portrait is a private, perceptive mind attracted to symbolism, philosophy and questions without easy answers.

On November 7 the Sun usually sits at about 14° Scorpio, in the second decan, where Neptune is the sub-ruler alongside Pluto. From 10 to 19 degrees of Scorpio, the sub-ruler is Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces. Early-to-mid November birthdays tend to soften the sign's intensity with intuition, imagination and empathy. These Scorpios are often seen as perceptive in an almost uncanny way, reading undercurrents in a room and drawn to art, healing work or spiritual questions. Neptune can blur edges, so feelings may be absorbed from others or idealised beyond recognition. The combination is powerful when grounded: deep emotional insight paired with compassion, used to help people face what they would rather not see alone.

sections.heading: November 7 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 7th, you have a birthday number of 7 in its plain form. Numerology treats the birth day as a secondary influence, often visible in how a person thinks rather than what they do. The 7 has long been regarded as the seeker's number, linked with analysis, solitude and questions that do not have quick answers. Natives of the 7th are frequently described as observant, private and happiest when they can go deep into a subject. Time alone tends to recharge them, and trust in their intuition often grows as they learn when to stop overthinking.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one November 7 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22.

sections.heading: Born on November 7: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 7 is the 311st day of the year (312nd in a leap year). By November 23, 16 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Sagittarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 7, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on November 7 include Marie Curie (1867), Albert Camus (1913) and Leon Trotsky (1879).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 7?
faq.answer: November 7 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 7?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 7 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 2 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 22 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 7th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 7?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 7 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 7?
faq.answer: November 7 is also the birthday of Marie Curie (1867), Albert Camus (1913) and Leon Trotsky (1879). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
